summary: Parallel build plan: every o1 task split into S tasks plus the AI tasks; waves computed from depends_on.

tasks.title: kernel/ai: ModelClient contract, request/response types, usage accounting
accept: ModelClient, Request, Response, ToolCall, Usage, StreamEvent and Embedder exist exactly as spec/ai/mocks.md sec. 2 (CONTRACT header)
Every Request carries FeatureID; a Request without FeatureID -> ErrNoFeature
Usage is recorded per feature id (tokens in/out, cost micro-cents); no prompt or completion text is persisted (AI-R-005 test)

tasks.title: Fixture format, loader, prompt hash and fixture lint
accept: Fixture YAML (mocks.md sec. 4) loads; prompt hash = sha256 of canonical JSON of {feature, system, messages, tools} with volatile fields (ids, timestamps) masked
Lint: every features.json id has a fixture dir with ok, error_429, timeout, injection; missing one -> make check fails naming it
Lint rejects fixtures without synthetic: true

tasks.title: go.mod with allowed deps and cmd main stubs
accept: go build ./... succeeds; each main.go only parses flags and calls kernel/boot (no logic)
go.mod requires only modules in the AGENTS.md allowed list
Each of ARC-I-040, ARC-U-017 has a // rule: tag in this task's code and a test named after it

tasks.title: Makefile check, rule coverage and layering test
accept: make check runs gofmt, go vet, go test ./..., spec-lint (python3 -I tools/o2_lint.py --spec spec --strict, exits 1 on any mechanical finding or a judgment count above tools/o2_lint.baseline.json) and openapi lint; all green on empty repo
Rule-coverage check (tools/rule_coverage.py): every rule id in spec/rules/*.json appears in some task's rule_ids in docs/TASKS.md; one unmapped id fails make check
CI fails if any file under kernel/ or app/legal/ imports another module's <m>/store package (layering test, like Paploo internal/layering)

tasks.title: CI workflow and e2e runner with suite auto-discovery
accept: Unit tests run with no network and no Docker; integration tests carry //go:build integration and read COUNSEL_TEST_DB
test/e2e/run.sh runs every test/e2e/suites/*.sh it finds (no per-suite registration), so suite tasks never edit run.sh
CI runs make check on every push and e2e on the wave branch

tasks.title: web/ scaffold: Vite, Vitest, React, feature auto-discovery
accept: npm run test (vitest) passes and make check runs it
web/src/app/features.ts discovers web/src/features/*/feature.ts with import.meta.glob, so feature tasks never edit a shared file
AGENTS.md allowed deps row Front end lists Vite and Vitest; docs/QUESTIONS.md has a Q entry recording why (build and unit-test tooling for web/)

tasks.title: app/legal registration extension points (per-package register.go)
accept: app/legal/register.go is func Register(r registry.Registry) error and calls every package in modules.go; each package register.go keeps a registrars list that feature files append to from init(), so feature tasks add files instead of editing a shared one

app/legal/flags.go defines every verify flag (billing.card_surcharge, billing.contingency_fees, billing.solicitors_act_verified, conflict.id_verification, deadline.ontario_pack, tax.verify_rules, trust.bylaw9_verified) with owner and expiry, all off by default; a test asserts each is off
Register against registrytest fake succeeds with zero registrations

tasks.title: kernel boot, flags and package stubs
accept: kernel/boot builds the kernel and calls app Register; kernel/all blank-imports every kernel package so modules self-register routes via kernel/server Mount from their own files
kernel/flags.Enabled(ctx, name) is false for any flag not explicitly turned on; flags are defined by the app at boot
Every kernel package has a doc.go stub so wave tasks only add files

tasks.title: Kernel boundary ratchet tests
accept: go list -deps ./kernel/... contains no package under app/: a kernel file importing app/legal/matter fails make check

Legal-term scan over kernel/ (Go identifiers, strings, comments, SQL, YAML, web/src/kernel): every term in tools/kernel_terms.txt (matter, trust, lawyer, licensee, paralegal, solicitor, client ledger, retainer, conflict check, ethical wall, court, docket, HST, GST, QST, LSO, By-Law, Clio, Ontario, bill of costs) fails unless the exact (file, term) is in tools/kernel_allow.txt; test fixture plants 'retainer' in kernel/money and expects failure
Ratchet: kernel_allow.txt and kernel_bindings.txt line counts may only go down; a commit that adds a line fails CI with 'kernel ratchet grew'
kernel_bindings.txt lists every kernel-layer table column that FKs into an app schema (e.g. cal.deadline.matter_id); a new such FK not listed fails the test (read from a4 JSON layer tags)

Gate kind slugs, capability ids, report ids and rule-pack ids registered by app/legal must not use a kernel module prefix (core., gate., platform., audit.); existing core.trust_signatory is the only allowlisted exception (Q-K1)

tasks.title: Import api/openapi.yaml with contract-diff test

Each of ARC-I-002 has a // rule: tag in this task's code and a test named after it

GET /healthz and GET /v1/models; container healthcheck flag; no network calls out

tasks.title: kernel/numseq: gapless number series

tasks.title: test/fakes/llm: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses protocol

Fits one agent session: if it does not, stop and split in docs/QUESTIONS.md

tasks.title: test/fakes/llm: faults, latency, token usage and request journal
accept: Fixture or header X-Fake-Fault selects 429 (with retry-after), 500, 529 overloaded, mid-stream disconnect, malformed JSON, timeout; latency_ms and per-chunk delay honoured
usage tokens come from the fixture, else a deterministic estimate (len/4); GET /_journal returns feature id, hash, protocol, status and usage per call (no bodies unless -dump-bodies is set)
POST /_reset clears the journal and per-test sequence counters

tasks.title: test/fakes/llm: embeddings endpoint
accept: POST /v1/embeddings returns deterministic vectors (dimension from config, default 1024) from sha256 of the input; fixture can pin vectors so named texts are near or far
Cosine of identical texts = 1; pinned near-duplicates >= 0.95; unrelated < 0.2
